title: Restore the restrained glass Agent Orb
goal: Bring the reusable Agent Orb back to the approved glass-sphere design with a low-cost idle pulse and stronger state-driven thinking motion.
context: Issue #429's latest source audit found the current AgentOrb still uses rotating circular strokes, partial arcs, and orbiting dots, contradicting AGENTS.md and the canonical splash Design Data, which specify a glossy translucent sphere with a glass rim/highlight and no rings or particles.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify PersonalAgent.xcodeproj, Kernel, Runtime, or unrelated screens.
Do not add orbit rings, particles, rotation loops, global timers, or avatar artwork.
Do not change navigation, Agent state semantics, or startup error handling.
Do not claim visual acceptance without physical iPhone verification.
acceptance_criteria: AgentOrb is rendered as a glossy glass sphere with a colored core, restrained rim/highlight, and soft shadow.
A subtle idle pulse is visible while the Orb is on screen; active/thinking states increase motion without rings or particles.
No rotating gradients/arcs, orbiting dots, or continuous rotation state remain in AgentOrb.
The existing AgentOrb API, accessibility label, and state inputs remain intact.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head; physical visual acceptance remains a separate gate.
verification: Review AgentOrb source for only sphere layers and state-driven scale animation.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single logical task commit if native build fails or the Orb loses its state-driven animation; retain the approved sphere-only visual constraint.
